goblinlabour.book.page.1:
§lGoblin Labour§r

Goblins are small workers that dig, chop and farm for you.

Each one lives in a Goblin Straw Bed and works from there.

Goblins call for help in chat.
goblinlabour.book.page.2:
§lCrafting§r

9 Rotten Flesh = Goblin Meat Pack

Smelt the pack = Goblin Blank

6 Hay Bales, lower two rows = Straw Bed

Blank + Torch = Head
Blank + 2 Sticks = Staff
goblinlabour.book.page.3:
§lA new goblin§r

Place the bed and right-click it with a Goblin Blank. The goblin appears with a name and is bound to that bed.

Break the bed and the goblin returns into the blank, tools included.
goblinlabour.book.page.4:
§lThe home§r

Around every bed lies a home of 11 x 11 x 5 blocks. Goblins never dig there.

Beds whose homes touch share one flat.

Hold the Goblin Head to see the borders.
goblinlabour.book.page.5:
§lThe bed menu§r

Right-click a bed to pick a job. The radius counts from the bed.

§lRest§r: stay home
§lChop§r: fell trees, replant
§lFarm§r: harvest crops, replant
§lCollect§r: pick up loose items
goblinlabour.book.page.6:
§lThe staff§r

Left-click picks goblins. They glow and follow you.

Right-click a block:
floor = dig down
ceiling = dig up
wall = tunnel

Sneak + right-click opens the settings first.
goblinlabour.book.page.7:
§lStaff orders§r

Defaults: 3 x 3 shaft with stairs, down to bedrock or up to the surface. Tunnels are 3 x 3 and 32 blocks long.

All picked goblins work on the order together. One order per spot.
goblinlabour.book.page.8:
§lTools and loot§r

Right-click a goblin to open its inventory. Tools go in the top row and never wear out.

Goblins only break what their tool allows. Loot fills the other row.
goblinlabour.book.page.9:
§lCopper chests§r

When its storage is full the goblin walks home and unloads into copper chests inside the flat.

If nothing fits, it lies down and complains in chat until you make room.
goblinlabour.book.page.10:
§lGood to know§r

Goblins place free torches and plug lava and water with cobblestone.

Scaffold takes them up to logs and out of pits. It vanishes after two minutes.

Monsters ignore goblins, lava does not.
goblinlabour.book.page.11:
§lDeath§r

A dead goblin respawns at its bed after a few seconds and keeps its tools.

The loot it carried drops where it died. The goblin walks back to collect it.
